<subject>Re: Mulga Ridge expansion agreement</subject>
<body>
Jon,

It is expected that by the time the hard costs referenced in #2 are incurred, the project will be in CAPEX Phase 2 (or its successor/take out vehicle) since construction will be nearly complete. Costs incurred in #3 should be Phase 2 CAPEX costs, since this should be in the construction period, although it could be immediately prior to that time.

Whitney, I skipped Amy on this email since she is out of town, and reviewed this agreement before she left.


Adam
